subject: Quick thought on the Roaring Fork website (and a live prototype)
body: Hi Roaring Fork team, I often find myself thinking about your wood-fired steaks and the rugged, upscale lodge setting over in Austin. While looking through your site recently, I noticed a couple of quick opportunities to make it even easier for diners: adding clear contact details and address info right in the footer, and fine-tuning local search markup so more food enthusiasts find you easily when searching for American Western cuisine. Since I specialize in independent web design, I took a little time to build a modern, high-performance prototype for you. It features a warm editorial layout, interactive menu highlights, and an atmosphere gallery designed to capture that true western bistro feel. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644cc7b14ae180b-0x3106b969068a2f4-lree1cxmy.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added direct phone and address details clearly in the website footer
Optimized local schema markup and meta descriptions for local search terms
